name: Mei Tan
bio:
Mei Tan's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for complex systems. Growing up in Singapore, she was captivated by the intricate engineering behind Formula 1 cars, often spending hours dissecting technical articles and simulations. This led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics. Her early career involved stints at various automotive manufacturers, before she transitioned to motorsport, driven by a desire to push the boundaries of performance. 

As a technical director, Mei is known for her data-driven approach and her ability to translate complex engineering concepts into actionable strategies for the team. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every member feels empowered to contribute their expertise. Her distinctive strength lies in her capacity to see both the minute details and the overall strategic picture, enabling her to optimize performance across various technical domains. Currently at Hendrick Motorsports, she is focused on enhancing aerodynamic efficiency and improving the overall reliability of the cars.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight hair with subtle highlights
physical.description: Mei has a focused look, framed by her shoulder-length dark hair, and always carries herself with a quiet confidence.
